method: FCDO Foreign Travel Advice (OGL v3.0), each cross-checked against the official local source in localUrl. Unconfirmed (MAR, EGY, ALB) stay pending.

countries.note: FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. FCDO adds that 999 dialled from a UK mobile is transferred to Greek emergency services.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services.
Local (italia.it, official tourism portal) lists 112 as the single European emergency number, 118 medical, 115 fire; it also lists Polizia di Stato 113. FCDO gives 112 for police.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. FCDO also mentions SATE tourist assistance offices (no phone number given).
Local service-public page lists 15 SAMU, 17 Police secours, 18 Pompiers, 112, and 114 for deaf/hard of hearing (SMS/app).

No FCDO page for the UK. gov.uk: call 999 for police emergencies; NHS (https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/urgent-and-emergency-care-services/when-to-call-999/) confirms 999 for ambulance; London Fire Brigade (https://www.london-fire.gov.uk/safety/calling-999/) confirms 999 for fire. Non-emergency: police 101, NHS 111.
BBK (federal civil protection office): 110 and 112 nationwide; 112 for fire and rescue/ambulance. FCDO lists no separate shared number (112 is also the EU number).
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. EU page notes the Netherlands uses 112 as its only national emergency number.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. EU page notes Portugal uses 112 as its only national emergency number.
oesterreich.gv.at lists 112 Euro-Notruf, 122 Feuerwehr, 133 Polizei, 144 Rettungsdienst (also 140 mountain rescue).
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. Slug czech-republic redirects to czechia.
gov.pl: 997 Policja, 998 fire, 999 medical; same site states 112 is the national emergency number. FCDO does not list 112 for Poland.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services. EU page notes Romania uses 112 as its only national emergency number.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services.
Georgian National Tourism Administration page: 112 Public Safety Command Center covers emergency medical care, police and fire. 112.gov.ge and police.ge were unreachable from here.
Montenegro regulator EKIP lists 112 (single European emergency number) plus 122 police, 123 fire/rescue, 124 ambulance, 129 sea rescue. FCDO lists only 112.
FCDO lists only 112 (ambulance, fire, police). EU 112 page confirms 112 works everywhere in the EU for all services.
ch.ch (federal portal): 112 European number, Polizei 117, Feuerwehr 118, Ambulanz 144. BAKOM page agrees.
Abu Dhabi government tourism page lists Police 999, Ambulance 998, Fire 997. Federal u.ae and moi.gov.ae were unreachable from here.
Thai government page: 191 general emergency (police, fire, rescue), 1669 medical, 199 fire, 1155 Tourist Police. FCDO lists 191 as the all-services number.
JNTO: 119 fire and ambulance, 110 police.
National Portal of India: 112 integrated ERSS helpline (police, fire, health); legacy 100 police, 101 fire, 102 ambulance also listed. FCDO also gives Ministry of Tourism helpline 1800111363.

Provincial police (Dien Bien) page: 113 police, 114 fire/rescue, 115 medical; 112 is the national search-and-rescue/disaster line (FCDO lists it as national search and rescue, so not used as shared). Operated in Vietnamese only.
USA.gov: if you are experiencing an emergency, dial 911.
Canada.ca (Parks Canada): call 911 for police, fire or ambulance. FCDO also lists coastguard 18004634393.
gob.mx: 911 is the national emergency number (replaced 060/065/066 etc.). FCDO also lists Mexico City Tourist Police +52 55 5207 4155 (city-only, so tourist_police left null).
